body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Berlin, Germany. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5 km. It starts at Alte Nationalgalerie, Bodestraße 1-3, 10178 Berlin, Germany. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Alte Nationalgalerie. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Take a self-guided audio walk that's perfect for history and art fans. Your ticket to the Alte Nationalgalerie on Museum Island is included, letting you start your journey through Berlin at your own pace.
>
> (!) Please note, that this tour does not include an audio guide inside the Alte Nationalgalerie.
>
> The walk starts outside the Alte Nationalgalerie and finishes at the Memorial to the Gendarmenmarkt Square. During this tour, you'll see major landmarks like the Brandenburg Gate, Berlin Cathedral, Humboldt University, Tiergarten Park, the Reichstag building, and many more. These spots tell tales from Germany's grand belle époque under the Kaiser to the tragic Nazi period, showing both remembrance and resilience today. Get ready to explore Berlin’s rich history and stunning architecture through your own eyes, reflecting on what you see and learn along the way.
